coverage_reporting.mask_coverage: mask_images / defect_image_count; GOOD images are excluded because they have no ground-truth mask.

pixel_ap_reporting.macro_definition: Unweighted mean of per-category Pixel AP across the 15 categories.
pixel_ap_reporting.micro_definition: Pooled Pixel AP/AUROC are unavailable to avoid all-test ranking memory; micro operating-point metrics sum confusion counts after applying each category's own GOOD-validation threshold.

exact_hash_caveat.text: No exact byte-hash overlap was found for train-vs-validation, train-vs-test, or validation-vs-test; perceptual duplicates are not ruled out.

image_index.offset_unit: flattened pixels into each score map and label map
